title: "Exploring NYC Public School Test Result Scores"
format: html
---

```{python}
# Import
import pandas as pd

# Load data
schools_data = pd.read_csv("schools.csv")
```

```{python}
# Preview the data
schools_data.info()  # Column types
schools_data.head()  # First few rows
schools_data.shape  # Dimensions: (rows, columns)

```

### Which NYC schools have the best math results?

```{python}

# Filter schools with strong math performance (≥ 640 out of 800)
best_math_schools = schools_data[schools_data["average_math"] >= 640]

# Select relevant columns
best_math_schools = best_math_schools[["school_name", "average_math"]]

# Sort by average_math in descending order
best_math_schools = best_math_schools.sort_values(by="average_math", ascending=False)

# View result
print(best_math_schools)
```

### What are the top 10 performing schools based on the combined SAT scores?

```{python}
# Calculate total SAT score
schools_data['total_SAT'] = (
    schools_data['average_math'] +
    schools_data['average_reading'] +
    schools_data['average_writing']
)

# Select relevant columns
top_10_schools = schools_data[['school_name', 'total_SAT']]

# Sort and extract top 10
top_10_schools = top_10_schools.sort_values(by='total_SAT', ascending=False).head(10)

# View result
print(top_10_schools)

```

### Which single borough has the largest standard deviation in the combined SAT score?

```{python}
# Group by borough and calculate required stats
borough_stats = (
    schools_data.groupby("borough")
    .agg(
        num_schools=("school_name", "count"),  # Total schools per borough
        average_SAT=("total_SAT", "mean"),  # Mean SAT score
        std_SAT=("total_SAT", "std"),  # SAT score variability
    )
    .reset_index()
)

# Round numeric values to two decimal places
borough_stats[["average_SAT", "std_SAT"]] = borough_stats[
    ["average_SAT", "std_SAT"]
].round(2)

# Borough with the largest standard deviation
largest_std_dev = borough_stats.sort_values(by="std_SAT", ascending=False).head(1)

# View result
print(largest_std_dev)
```
